title: stream-circuit-breaker-contract-regtest-with-structured-output-fuzz
creator: Asha Nambiar
description: Create a focused contract/regression test that validates streaming responses + function/tool calls + structured JSON outputs under circuit-breaker and partial-response scenarios. This ticket implements a lightweight harness that runs in CI as a gate (ci/compat/stream-cb-regtests) and produces stable artifacts that can be diffs against a golden-seed corpus. The test must exercise: (1) mid-stream tool invocation and subsequent rollback/fallback to alternate model variants, (2) partial JSON emissions (prefix then resumed) and schema reassembly, (3) KV-cache priming and non-deterministic latency/jitter handling, (4) circuit-breaker behavior when a downstream tool returns 5xx or times out. We will use a seeded + fuzzed prompt corpus to cover edge cases while keeping a stable golden subset for CI flakiness investigations.
acceptance_criteria: CI job ci/compat/stream-cb-regtests runs on PRs targeting runtime and streaming infra and completes in < 8 minutes for the golden subset
Harness asserts structured-output schema on reassembled JSON after partial streaming and recovers from mid-stream tool errors via configured fallback policy
Deterministic signatures (stable fingerprint) generated for golden seeds; new failures produce a human-readable diff artifact stored in artifacts/stream-cb/<run-id>/
Circuit-breaker scenarios cause recorded graceful degradation paths (fallback to smaller model or cached KV prefix) and the run logs contain routing decision traces
Test manifests and seed corpus added under testdata/stream-cb and referenced in CI; PR includes at least one end-to-end run in CI passing the golden subset
notes: This harness is intended to be lightweight compared to the full canonical golden-suite; it targets the high-risk intersection of streaming + toolcalls + structured output. Use feature flags to gate longer fuzz runs. Keep golden subset small (~50 seeds) and maintain a larger seed corpus (~1000) for nightly fuzzing.

run_instructions: Checkout runtime repo, run pytest tests/integration/test_stream_cb.py::TestStreamCircuitBreaker::test_golden_subset --ci-flag; artifacts are uploaded to S3 prefix s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/stream-cb/<run-id>/; to reproduce locally use docker-compose -f dev/stream-cb-compose.yaml up and run the test suite.
